event_name: Williams Martini Racing Document 41 Date 27 May 2018 Time 15:57 2018 MONACO GRAND PRIX 23 - 27 May 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 35 appeared to be worked on while in the pits for the stop & go penalty.
offence: Alleged breach of Article 38.4(d) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
reason: While a member of the team was in close proximity of the car, the car was not worked on. Nish Shetty Jose Abed Danny Sullivan Eric Barrabino
rules_referenced: Article 38.4(d) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations Decision No further action
title: 2018 Monaco Grand Prix Decision Car 35 Car Being Worked On During A 10 Sec Stop Go41
